title: Double Gates
text:
Walkthrough

The next obstacle that you will face is a pair of doors after a a pair ropes and a pair of blades. These two doors can be raised by hanging onto one of the two ropes. You should slowly close if you aren't weighing the rope down.

There is also a cart that can be moved. It needs to be placed just left of the rope hanging between the two blades.

To be able to raise the first door, you will have to climb to the platform that is up, grab the rope, and wait for it to stop (you climb up to avoid the blades). Next, you have to quickly jump off, then run to the lower floor and catch the bottom of the rope just before it reaches the blades. Finally, grab the second rope to raise the other door, and proceed to the next chapter.
